scripts.typecheck: tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/functions
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cherrytree "vitest run --project rules"
scripts.test:agent: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cherrytree "uv run --directory apps/agent pytest"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:agent && npm run build
scripts.check:agent: cd apps/agent && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright && uv run pytest -q
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase use dev && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:functions:dev: firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:hosting:dev: npm run build:dev && firebase use dev && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:agent:dev: gcloud run deploy agent --source apps/agent --project cherrytree-cofounder-agree-dev --region us-west2 --service-account agent-service@cherrytree-cofounder-agree-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com --allow-unauthenticated --timeout 3600 --set-env-vars GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=cherrytree-cofounder-agree-dev --set-secrets ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:latest,LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY=LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY:latest,LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY=LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY:latest
